name: handily-simple-view
description: One short row for each tool call, except a call that asks you or shows you a plan, with buttons to open and copy a Bash output, /simple to switch it and /simple show to print a call in full.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Whether tool calls draw as one short row (on) or as Claude Code draws them (off) when a session starts. /simple toggles one session.
